text: Evidence record, not authority: the census of the two resolvePathIntent copies at base, the old-versus-new differential of each caller over one path corpus, its negative control, and a rule-6 mutant per predicate of the one copy and of the subpath guard. Generated by assemble_path_intent.py from the runs it names; do not edit.
rerun: From empty /tmp/la-b82/g and /tmp/la-b82/home, with both trees built (npm ci; npm run build): extract_path_intent.py <base> <lift-base>; extract_path_intent.py <head> <lift-head>; node path_intent_census.mjs <base> <lift-base> <head> <lift-head> /tmp/la-b82/piX/fx <out>/census.json --entries. The fixture path is fixed so every message naming it is byte-comparable between runs. A mutant runs as mutate.py <tree> <spec> <log>, from the tree root.

corpus.notReached: a link whose target cannot be read: readlink fails after lstat only in a race, so no on-disk corpus reaches that arm; the new test in state-directory.test.ts reaches it by patching readlinkSync, and mutants P8 and P9c are killed there

census.what: the daemon's own copy and the state directory's copy, both at base, over every path input
compared: realPath (the daemon copy calls it intendedRealPath)

reason.note: the state copy returned no reason at base; the one copy returns the daemon copy's reason (shared.againstDaemon), and neither stateRootViolation nor sessionsRootViolation reads it

dangling.note: no caller read it, so the one copy drops it

entries.what: the built syzygy entry of each tree, for every daemon pair with root <fixture>/root and every `dossier init` pair with clone <fixture>/root that the base caller refuses; exit, signal, stdout and stderr compared byte for byte

negativeControl.what: the one copy reading EACCES as a missing component, lifted into lift-neg; sessionsRootViolation reads the built dist and so runs unmutated here
negativeControl.old: if (code === 'ENOENT') return { resolved: true, realPath: candidate };
negativeControl.new: if (code === 'ENOENT' || code === 'EACCES') return { resolved: true, realPath: candidate };
